name: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation.  A Fool's Stout.  I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.

And adventurer, don't keep this stuff too long without using it.  Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear.  So it won't stay fresh forever.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Fool's Stout back to Kravel in the Shimmering Flats.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Wonderful! Fizzlebub came through! I'll remember that next time I see him.

And thank you, adventurer. You're doing a great job, and we both stand to make a lot of money from this...
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer. Was Fizzlebub able to help us?
